issue.title: Show Resources for the whole pericope in pericope mode [Viewing and listening to resources Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the viewing and listening to resources audit (#531, epic #526).

**Severity:** High  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local run of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios F.15)

## Summary
In pericope mode, the Resources tab loads and labels only the pericope's anchor verse. The Bible tab sets `selectedVerse` to `unit.anchorVerse` (`src/app/tabs/BibleTab.tsx:117-124`), and `ResourcesTab` passes that single verse to the TN / TQ / Images loaders (`src/app/tabs/ResourcesTab.tsx:93-113`). fluent-api only exposes single-verse routes (`/translation-resources/{notes|questions|images}/{book}/{chapter}/{verse}`).

## Expected
Resources for the whole active pericope: one note per verse or passage covered by the unit (#189), with the pericope range in the header.

## Actual
F.15: in pericope mode, Bible and Record show pericopes, but Resources shows "Mark 1:1" and only verse 1's content, as in verse mode.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Settings → drafting unit Pericope.
2. Select a multi-verse pericope on the Bible tab.
3. Open Resources and compare with the notes for the second verse of the pericope in verse mode.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] fluent-api serves TN / TQ / Images for a verse range (or mobile fans out per verse; decide with the API owner). The fluent-api issue is opened at implementation time and linked here.
- [ ] Resources covers every verse in the active pericope (fluent-api range route, or client fan-out; decide with API).
- [ ] Header shows the pericope range.
- [ ] Per-unit scroll/accordion restore keys on the unit, not the anchor verse.
- [ ] Unit tests for the range loader.
- [ ] Android device QA in pericope and verse modes.

## Related
- Spec: #188, #189, #408
- fluent-api translation-resources (fluent-api #273 / PR #274)
- Sibling audit: #534
- Parent audit: #531 (epic #526)
- Related gap: #594 (also needs fluent-api translation-resources changes)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/viewing-and-listening-to-resources/README.md` (PR #590)

comments.body:
Opened fluent-api follow-up for first-party verse-range TN/TQ/Images endpoints: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/375

Mobile slice in progress: client fan-out across the active pericope’s verses (merge/dedupe by id), header shows the pericope range, accordion/scroll keyed by `BibleUnit.key`.
